thread:
Maya (Sales): Greenline sent back the security questionnaire. Main blocker: BYO-CMK on HSM, per-key rotation windows, and an exception workflow. Can we confirm POC feasibility?
Jordan (SE): Short answer: yes for POC on Dedicated/Private. We support wrapped imports and attestation. Exceptions via approval ticket which sets a no-auto-rotate flag.
Claire (Greenline-IT): They need FIPS attestation, key import flow docs, rotation TTL per key, multi-region mirroring SLA, and 7y audit retention. Also want an ops escalation path if auto-rotate fails.
Sam (CryptoEng): Technical notes: vendor attestation available (we can supply cert chain). Rotation is policy-driven; exceptions create an override with TTL and dual-approval. We'll add a post-rotate cache flush hook to avoid stale tokens. Mirroring is async with configurable staleness; SLA depends on region pair.
Priya (Security): Security baseline: symmetric keys rotate <=90d, signing keys <=365d. If exception granted require MFA+dual-approval for manual rotates, SIEM forwarding of audit logs, and limited RBAC. Need legal to sign off on exception TTLs.
Alex (Billing): Pricing: HSM ops billed per-1k ops + hourly HSM seat for Dedicated. For POC we can provide a credit estimate; committed tiers reduce per-op cost. Claire, what is expected POC QPS?
Claire (Greenline-IT): Prod peak 40 encrypt QPS, 5 decrypt/sign QPS, ~2k/day tokenization. POC ~5% of prod. We will provide S3 ARN for audit export.
Jordan (SE): Proposed escalation runbook: 1) auto-rotate fails -> alert eng-oncall; 2) 15m unresolved -> create ticket to customer contacts; 3) 45m escalate to oncall lead and customer pager. Snippet:
```
- detect: rotation-failure -> notify #eng-oncall -> wait 15m
- unresolved -> create-ticket(template=rotate-fail) -> wait 45m
- escalate -> customer-pager
```
Sam (CryptoEng): Note on manual exceptions: must ensure atomic key swap and KV invalidation. We'll implement a hook to flush caches post-swap. For audit logs 7y: we export to customer S3 bucket for long-term retention; default retention on Redwood is 1y.
Priya (Security): Audit export requires legal NDA for ceremony logs. For POC we can share anonymized ceremony summary; full logs under NDA.
Claire (Greenline-IT): OK to accept S3 export, will share ARN. NDA fine. Need attestation + last 3 months ceremony notes for POC.
Sam (CryptoEng): Will attach cert chain and anonymized ceremony summary to the ticket. Full logs available under NDA.
Maya (Sales): Action items: Sam attach attestation, Alex post POC pricing ballpark, Jordan publish runbook PR, Priya list controls for exceptions, Claire confirm TTL and share ARN.
deploy-bot: Created redwood-poc-greenline-2026-03, creds emailed to maya@redwood.com.
Maya (Sales): Scheduling sync with Greenline Thursday to walk runbook and pricing.
Alex (Billing): I'll post ballpark by EOD.
Jordan (SE): Will open runbook PR and ping oncall leads.
Maya (Sales): Marking thread for POC checklist. :thumbsup:
